## Validation

List checks actually run, difficult cases, and remaining limitations.

- [ ] Package is standalone and examples contain no private data.
- [ ] Source facts, unknowns, and review boundaries are preserved.
- [ ] Catalogs regenerated and no generated drift remains.
- [ ] Relevant tests pass; native client claims match actual evidence.
- [ ] Original content and license/attribution are correct.
